messages.subject: A quick and simple question...
parts:
Dear R users and developers,

I have a quick and may be a simple question...
Some colleagues keep asking me why I am using R (Lavaan or Lavaan.survey) instead of Mplus, which enables advanced SEM without errors.
How would you answer this question?

Thanks for your advice in advance
Sincerely,
Yonghwan Chang
